extraction.name: ScienceQA
extraction.description: A new benchmark consisting of 21k multimodal multiple choice questions with diverse science topics and annotations of their answers with corresponding lectures and explanations.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Questions in the SCIENCE QA dataset are sourced from open resources managed by IXL Learning, an online learning platform curated by experts in the field of K-12 education. The dataset includes problems that align with California Common Core Content Standards. The original science problems were downloaded and individual components were extracted based on heuristic rules. Invalid questions were manually removed. Semi-automated scripts were used to reformat lectures and solutions. A data exploration tool was developed to review examples, and incorrect annotations were manually revised by experts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open resources managed by IXL Learning, an online learning platform.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Invalid questions (e.g., single choice, faulty data, duplicates) were manually removed. If multiple correct answers applied, only one was kept. Answer options were shuffled. Semi-automated scripts were used to reformat lectures and solutions to distinguish special structures like tables and lists.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Invalid questions were manually removed. Answer options were shuffled. Semi-automated scripts were used to reformat lectures and solutions. A data exploration tool was used to review examples and manually revise incorrect annotations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset contains annotations of answers with corresponding lectures and explanations. These were sourced from the original IXL Learning resources. Incorrect annotations were manually revised by experts using a data exploration tool.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The collected data does not contain personally identifiable information or offensive content.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is proposed to diagnose multimodal understanding and multi-hop reasoning abilities of AI systems. It contributes to the development of K-12 education applications such as tutoring systems. The dataset does not contain user usage data or personally sensitive information. The authors adhere to the goal of AI for the common good and will remove antisocial data points based on feedback.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is restricted to non-commercial research purposes. The copyright belongs to the original authors (IXL Learning). The data is sourced from textbooks and may not represent all scientific domains or real-world scenarios. Models may fail to understand complex domain knowledge or fine-grained visual information in diagrams.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. The dataset is used to benchmark multimodal reasoning, multi-hop reasoning, and general artificial intelligence. It is also suitable for developing K-12 education applications.
